_how_to_use_this_template: 1. Copy this file to <TICKER>.json (e.g. AAPL.json) in this same folder.
2. Delete every key that starts with an underscore -- they are instructions, not data.
3. Fill in every value marked PLACEHOLDER using the source hints next to it.
4. Add any new peers to ../peer_universe.json if they aren't already there.
company: PLACEHOLDER -- full legal company name, e.g. 'Apple Inc.'
fiscal_year_end: PLACEHOLDER -- e.g. 'September' or 'December 31' -- check the 10-K cover page
as_of_date: PLACEHOLDER -- today's date, YYYY-MM-DD -- this is when you pulled market_data below
currency: USD millions (except per-share and price data)
sources: PLACEHOLDER -- list the exact filings/pages you pulled from, e.g. 'AAPL FY2025 Form 10-K (SEC EDGAR)'
notes: PLACEHOLDER -- flag anything estimated/approximated rather than directly sourced. Be honest here; it protects you in an interview.
latest_fiscal_year: PLACEHOLDER -- e.g. 'FY2025', must match a key in income_statement below
_income_statement_source_hint: 10-K Income Statement / 'Consolidated Statements of Operations'. Use 3 consecutive fiscal years.
_cash_flow_source_hint: 10-K 'Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows'. fcf = cfo + capex (capex is already negative).
_balance_sheet_source_hint: 10-K 'Consolidated Balance Sheets', most recent fiscal year-end only. total_debt = notes_payable + current portion of LT debt + long_term_debt.
_dcf_assumptions_hint: Write YOUR OWN thesis here -- do not copy another company's growth_path. growth_path is 5 numbers, one YoY growth rate per explicit forecast year.

dcf_assumptions.note: PLACEHOLDER -- one or two sentences on why this growth path, in plain English

_market_data_source_hint: Any live quote source (stockanalysis.com, Google Finance, your broker). beta is usually '5-year monthly' on most data providers.
